aspect_notes: Encircles Mono Lake; exposed mudflats subject to lake breeze and wave action
dominant_plants: Inland saltgrass (Distichlis spicata), Alkali sacaton (Sporobolus airoides)
secondary_plants: Nevada bulrush (Amphiscirpus nevadensis), Western sea-purslane (Sesuvium verrucosum)
ground_cover: Calcareous tufa crust, white alkali efflorescence, saline mud
rock_types: Lithified calcium carbonate tufa, lacustrine silt, diatomite

aspect_notes: Open valley floor and undulating alluvial fans; intense wind and high summer sun
dominant_plants: Big sagebrush (Artemisia tridentata), Rubber rabbitbrush (Ericameria nauseosa)
secondary_plants: Bitterbrush (Purshia tridentata), Desert peach (Prunus andersonii), Needle-and-thread grass (Hesperostipa comata)
ground_cover: Cryptobiotic soil crust, dry sand-gravel sheet, scattered basalt pebbles
rock_types: Quaternary rhyolitic pumice tephra, basalt gravel, granitic outwash sand

aspect_notes: Arid eastern slopes, Bodie Hills, and lower canyon walls; dry south-facing aspects
dominant_plants: Single-leaf pinyon pine (Pinus monophylla), Utah juniper (Juniperus osteosperma)
secondary_plants: Mountain mahogany (Cercocarpus ledifolius), Desert bitterbrush (Purshia glandulosa)
ground_cover: Sparse needle litter, bare weathered volcanic gravel, cheatgrass
rock_types: Tertiary andesitic breccia, rhyolite tuff, metamorphic hornfels

aspect_notes: Deep porous pumice flats south of lake and sheltered moraines; west and north aspects
secondary_plants: Sierra lodgepole pine (Pinus contorta var. murrayana), Greenleaf manzanita (Arctostaphylos patula)
ground_cover: Deep pine needle duff, fallen cones, rotten pumice mulch
rock_types: Rhyolitic pumice gravel, decomposed granite, morainal till
source: Rundel et al. Sierra Nevada Conifers

aspect_notes: Moist canyon bottoms, perennial creek margins (Lee Vining, Mill Creek), seep zones
dominant_plants: Quaking aspen (Populus tremuloides), Black cottonwood (Populus trichocarpa)
secondary_plants: Water birch (Betula occidentalis), Arroyo willow (Salix lasiolepis), Mountain alder (Alnus incana)
ground_cover: Lush forb understory, damp humus, horsetails, willow leaf litter
rock_types: Water-rounded granitic boulders, glacial outwash gravel, talus blocks

aspect_notes: High elevation cold slopes, glacial hanging valleys, Ellery/Tioga lakes, pass crests
dominant_plants: Sierra lodgepole pine (Pinus contorta var. murrayana), Whitebark pine (Pinus albicaulis)
secondary_plants: Western white pine (Pinus monticola), Mountain hemlock (Tsuga mertensiana)
ground_cover: Coarse grus sand, cushion plants, granite slabs, lichen crust
rock_types: Cretaceous Cathedral Peak granodiorite, Tioga metamorphic metavolcanics

aspect_notes: Windswept ridges, Mount Dana slopes, nunataks, periglacial talus and scree
dominant_plants: Sierra primrose (Primula suffrutescens), Sky pilot (Polemonium eximium)
secondary_plants: Alpine gold (Hulsea algida), Dana dwarf willow (Salix reticulata), Sedge turf (Carex spp.)
ground_cover: Bare shattered bedrock, frost-heaved boulder stripes, snowfield margins
rock_types: Metamorphic hornfels, red slate, weathered granodiorite, scree talus
